verdict.rationale: LM Studio supplies building blocks for background work. llmster is a headless daemon for servers and CI, there is a REST/OpenAI-like API for your own scripts, and models load on demand when a request arrives; a community user confirms the headless flow works from real tools. However, nothing shows built-in automations, schedules, triggers or autonomous background agent runs: Bionic is an interactive agent, so users must build the automation themselves with external scripts. Missing for 10: a native automation or scheduling feature, event triggers, unattended Bionic or agent task runs, and docs or hands-on evidence of autonomous background workflows.
